optimize_pose_theseus: optimize SE(3) pose using Theseus with neural field TSDF loss and ICP constraints
check_jacobians: check the jacobians of a Theseus cost function against torch autograd computed jacobians
pose_rmse: compute the RMSE of rotation in degrees and translation in meters between two pose batches
PoseOptimizer_addVariables: add sensor depth batch, pose batch, and frame IDs as optimization variables to the PoseOptimizer
PoseOptimizer_getOptimizedPoses: get the optimized SE(3) pose batch as a matrix or Theseus SE3 object after optimization
